(function preloadCustomerSprites(){
let pending=0;
for(const variant of CUSTOMER_SPRITE_VARIANTS){
customerSpriteImages[variant]={};
for(const [action,count] of Object.entries(CUSTOMER_ACTIONS)){
customerSpriteImages[variant][action]={};
for(const dir of CUSTOMER_DIRS){
customerSpriteImages[variant][action][dir]=[];
const frameCount=(action==='walk'&&(dir==='left'||dir==='right')&&(variant==='male'||variant==='elder'))?4:count;
for(let i=0;i<frameCount;i++){
pending++;
const img=new Image();
img.onload=()=>{pending--; if(pending<=0)customerSpritesReady=true;};
img.onerror=()=>{pending--; if(pending<=0)customerSpritesReady=true;};
const fname=`${variant}_${action}_${dir}_${i}.png`;
img.src=CUSTOMER_SPRITE_DATA[fname]||`posm_customer_sprites/${fname}`;
customerSpriteImages[variant][action][dir].push(img);
}
}
}
}
if(pending===0)customerSpritesReady=true;
})();
function customerVariantForCode(code){return CUSTOMER_VARIANT_BY_CODE[code]||CUSTOMER_SPRITE_VARIANTS[0]}
function initCustomerSpriteState(c){
c.variant=customerVariantForCode(c.code);
c.dir='down';
c.anim='idle';
c.animClock=Math.random()*0.5;
}
function setCustomerPose(c,action,dx=0,dy=0,dt=0){
if(Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy)>1e-5){
c.dir=Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?(dx<0?'left':'right'):(dy<0?'up':'down');
}
c.anim=action;
c.animClock=(c.animClock||0)+dt;
}
